en-us.jp_library_Opt_Apply_greeting: "Part-time duties are shelving books and helping readers. Pay is 1,200 yen an hour, settled daily. The shifts are nine to two and two to eight."
en-us.jp_library_Opt_Apply_done:
"That's registered. Please learn the shelf classifications first, and keep your voice low while working."
(Shifts can be changed in the source household's Management Jobs tab.)
en-us.jp_library_Opt_Quit_question: "Who would like to leave their post?"
en-us.jp_library_Opt_Quit_done: "That's registered. Thank you for your help. You're always welcome to come back and read."
en-us.jp_library_Opt_cancelLine: "Come back to the desk when you've decided."
